headlines.title: The Shopify Stock Rally Isn’t Done: Chart of the Week
headlines.summary: Shopify sales rose 32% in the second quarter of 2026, marking its fifth consecutive quarter of growth exceeding 30%.

headlines.title: Shopify (SHOP) Blocks AI Checkouts While Same Day Delivery Reaches More Merchants
headlines.summary: Shopify (NasdaqGS:SHOP) introduced a new policy blocking autonomous AI agents from completing checkout flows across its merchant network. The company framed the restriction as a way to reduce payment risk and system strain as agent-based ecommerce activity increases. Shopify merchants gained expanded access to Ecom NOW same-day delivery through a new integration focused on Canadian order fulfillment.

headlines.title: Ecom Logistics Launches Ecom NOW, Bringing Same-Day Delivery to Shopify Merchants' Own Storefronts
headlines.summary: Ecom Logistics today announced the launch of Ecom NOW, a same-day fulfillment and delivery experience for Shopify merchants. Ecom NOW connects a merchant's Shopify storefront to Ecom's connected order-to-door network, bringing fulfillment and last-mile delivery together in one seamless same-day experience. Customers who order eligible products before noon receive their order the same day by 9 PM. Learn more about Ecom Now.

headlines.title: Shopify Draws a Hard Line at the Checkout Gate
headlines.summary: Restricting the Autonomous Transaction Shopify has formalized its stance on agentic commerce by updating the robots.txt policy for its storefronts to explicitly prohibit autonomous agents from finalizing purchases. Effective July 15, 2025, the platform mandates that “Checkouts are for humans.

headlines.title: Analysts rank Shopify 31 places above Apple
headlines.summary: Analysts rank a 20-year-old company 31 places above Apple.

description: Shopify Inc., a commerce technology company, provides tools to start, scale, market, and run a business of various sizes in Canada, the United States, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, the Asia Pacific, and Latin America. The Company offers Shopify platform that enables merchants to manage products and inventory, process orders and payments, fulfill and ship orders, build customer relationships, source products, leverage analytics, and reporting and access financing for running their business across all of their sales channels, including web and mobile storefronts, physical retail locations, social media storefronts, and marketplaces. It also provides Shopify Payments, a fully integrated payment processing service that allows merchants to accept and process payment cards online and offline. In addition, the company engages in the sale of themes and apps; shipping labels through Shopify Shipping; point-of-sale hardware; advertising on the Shopify App Store; and Shop Campaigns for buyer acquisitions, as well as registration of domain names. The company was formerly known as Jaded Pixel Technologies Inc. and changed its name to Shopify Inc. in November 2011. Shopify Inc. was incorporated in 2004 and is based in Ottawa, Canada.
